questions.question: Can the editor verify the account of Cardano's medical degree, the 1570 imprisonment being in Rome, and the claim that Hamlet holds On Consolation during “To be or not to be”? These source claims have been preserved without correction.
Should “nor even negative numbers” be qualified to distinguish their existence from their status and acceptance in sixteenth-century European algebra? The source assertion is retained.
